note: Where the interior cells that behave like an exterior (Tribunal's five Mournhold districts) are presented to the outdoor converter as exterior cell blocks of their own (tools/presented_exterior.py). The blocks lie in one row south of every island of the three game files, one per cell in the order of the cells' names; a block and the ring of one cell around it must be free of the games' own exterior cells, and the tool stops when it is not.
